nodes.label: Hermes Zalo platform adapter (hermes-plugin/)
nodes.rationale: Bundled and auto-installed into ~/.hermes/plugins/zalo/ with zalo-platform enabled in config.yaml so users need not place files manually.

nodes.label: Node.js bridge (server.js)
nodes.rationale: Thin Node bridge exists to cross the language gap between TypeScript zca-js and the Python Hermes agent.

nodes.label: publish.yml npm release workflow (provenance)
nodes.rationale: Publishing on v* tags with --provenance ties packages to the repo+workflow; optional move to npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC) to go tokenless.

nodes.label: zca-js (API Zalo cá nhân không chính thức)
nodes.norm_label: zca-js (api zalo ca nhan khong chinh thuc)

nodes.label: zca-js (unofficial personal Zalo API)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over unofficial Python Zalo clients because it is more actively maintained, tracks Zalo protocol changes, and exposes a richer 145-method API; the cost (TypeScript vs Python Hermes) is paid by a thin Node bridge.

nodes.label: Action permission policy (5 danger groups)
nodes.rationale: Classifies 145 zca-js actions into read/send/interact/manage/destructive; precedence denylist > allowlist > destructive gate > allowed groups; destructive is off even when groups=all to prevent dangerous automation.

nodes.label: Info-call rate limiting (anti account-lock)
nodes.rationale: zca-js is unofficial; hammering getUserInfo/getGroupInfo risks temporary blocks, so results are TTL-cached, serialized with a minimum gap, and backed off exponentially (cap 5 min) serving stale cache.

nodes.label: Sender/thread allowlists and ZALO_GROUP_MODE
nodes.rationale: Telegram-style adapter-side gating: empty allowlists allow everyone; group mention detection uses real uid match (mentions/quotedOwnerId) rather than text guessing. Wizard sets GROUP_MODE=off when no group is picked (asymmetric default).

nodes.label: SSE /events stream with Last-Event-ID replay
nodes.rationale: Heartbeat every 15s plus ring-buffer replay via Last-Event-ID lets the adapter reconnect with backoff without losing events.

nodes.label: Undo cache (msgId->cliMsgId, daily JSONL)
nodes.rationale: Persisted to disk under ~/.hermes-zalo/climsgids/ and reloaded on startup so message recall survives restarts.

nodes.label: Unofficial API account-lock risk
nodes.rationale: Use a secondary Zalo account; Zalo may rate-limit or lock automating accounts.
